policy.full_text: Full texts are fetched into .cache/corpus for permitted local study. Work-level rights describe the work, not blanket permission for its editions. Modern witnesses remain modern_cache_only unless documentary evidence supports complete-file redistribution. A witness publication record in this registry binds any decision to its lock.json SHA-256 and distinguishes work, edition and provider rights. Cache-only decisions override work labels. noncommercial_text requires a documented redistribution decision; study intent or repository-owner clearance alone is insufficient. Existing public_domain_text witnesses without a publication record retain legacy eligibility, not a newly audited clearance. PDF and DOC witnesses are not staged. Records retain edition-qualified locators and existing excerpt caps.
policy.authority: Records are candidates until reviewed. Nothing here is a fatwā.

Both witnesses are held cache_only at witness level.
